description:
## Problem
Before `benchbox submit` can direct contributors to `develop`, four concrete gaps block safe bundle intake on `develop`:
1. `.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml` (`pull_request_target`) fires only on `published-results`, not `develop`.
2. Merging to `develop` immediately triggers `site-inputs.yml` and live Explorer deployment, yet nothing mechanically blocks auto-merge on external bundle PRs.
3. `publication/ledger-seed.json` is unmatched in `.github/ci-units.yml`, causing seed PRs (such as #4317) to fall through to `core` and run four medium shards plus both correctness gates.
4. `publication/ledger-seed.json` still carries stale `published_only` / `legacy_overlay` categories cut from `origin/published-results`, `scripts/publication/check_corpus_bijection.py` still defaults `--accepted-ref` to `origin/published-results`, and `tests/unit/docs/test_publication_architecture.py` still pins `published-results` as the archive.

## Change
1. Extend `.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml` (`pull_request_target`) to `develop` with strict `paths: ["results-data/bundles/**"]`, checking out only trusted `develop` base validator code and running the data-only file guard before reading any PR artifact (rejecting any PR that mixes bundle files with code/workflow edits).
2. Mechanically enforce manual review / no auto-merge on external bundle PRs by automatically applying the `no-auto-merge` label (enforced by `hold`) and verifying `make pr-arm` refuses them.
3. Audit and adapt `develop`'s required ruleset checks (`core`, `docs`, `explorer`, `results-data`, `hold`, `review-gate`, `release-v2 probe`) so fork PRs touching only `results-data/bundles/**` and `results-data/corpus-inventory.json` pass required checks cleanly without running heavy code tests or stalling on secret-scoped jobs.
4. Classify `publication/ledger-seed.json` in `.github/ci-units.yml` under the corpus unit rather than `core`, with unit tests in `tests/unit/scripts/test_ci_units.py`.
5. Rewrite `scripts/publication/create_ledger_seed.py`, `publication/ledger-seed.json`, and `scripts/publication/check_corpus_bijection.py` (updating its default `--accepted-ref`) to cut accepted + withdrawn entries from `develop` (dropping `published_only` and `legacy_overlay`).
6. Rewrite `tests/unit/docs/test_publication_architecture.py` to name `develop` as the archive without weakening any surviving invariant (acceptance != observed deployment, manual review / no auto-merge, accepted bytes never purged).

## Decision gates
- STOP if enabling fork PRs on `develop` requires changing a hosted GitHub branch ruleset, environment secret policy, or `review-gate` exemption — report the exact ruleset change and get owner approval before touching repository settings.
- STOP if `pull_request_target` on `develop` would ever execute or import code from the PR head branch: all scripts and validators must run strictly from the trusted `develop` base checkout.
- Keep `published-results` working untouched until Step 5 (post-release). Do not weaken `validate-submission.yml` on `published-results`.

## Verification rubric
- Pass: unit tests fail before and pass after for `ci-units.yml` (`publication/ledger-seed.json` does not request heavy code tests), workflow guard tests (`validate-submission.yml` rejects mixed bundle+code PRs on `develop` and applies `no-auto-merge`), `create_ledger_seed.py` and `check_corpus_bijection.py` (accepted/withdrawn schema cut from `develop`, default `--accepted-ref` updated), and `test_publication_architecture.py`; `make pr-preflight` and hosted `review-gate` pass on the merged head.
- Fail: any code from a fork PR head is executed under `pull_request_target`, an external bundle PR can be auto-merged, or `test_publication_architecture.py` drops manual-review / no-purge / acceptance-vs-observation checks.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Maintainability first (`[MAINTAINER-001]`). No explanatory comments or docstrings in first-party Python (`make comment-policy-check`). Stage named paths only; commit with pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution. Heavy work only via `make pr-preflight` / `make heavy-run`; never bypass `~/.benchbox/test.lock` or admission. Soundness paths touched (`.github/workflows/`, `publication/`, `scripts/publication/`): arm only after hosted `review-gate` passes on the current head and all review threads are resolved.
